rationale: Textbook monetary transmission. The direction sign is the typer's sign for the policy-rate surprise (positive = tighter than expected). A tighter surprise raises rates_expectation; higher expected rates lower long-duration bond prices (TLT -), tighten risk appetite (risk_appetite -) and strengthen the dollar (UUP +); risk appetite moves equities and high-yield credit in the same direction (SPY +, HYG +). Documentation, not data.
